heroHeadline: Day 9,009 — ISIS-K Kills Badakhshan Acting Governor; 33-Day Strike Pause; UNAMA Mandate Expires June 17 — SC Vote Imminent; Russia-Taliban Pact Implementation Begins; Jawid Niazi Day 32
heroSubtitle: June 7, 2026 is Day 9,009 since the US launched Operation Enduring Freedom and Day 102 of Pakistan's Operation Ghazab lil-Haq. ISIS-K killed the Taliban-appointed Acting Governor of Badakhshan province via car bomb on June 6 — one of ISIS-K's highest-profile hits against Taliban administration in 2026 — demonstrating the group's continued reach in northeastern Afghanistan despite Taliban counterterrorism operations. No confirmed Pakistani cross-border airstrikes for a 33rd consecutive day since the May 5 Dangam (Kunar) strike. Russia-Taliban Military-Technical Cooperation Agreement implementation is now underway after Taliban Defense Minister Yaqoob confirmed 'commencement within days' on June 5 — covering repair of Russian-made weapons, helicopter maintenance, and air defense development. The UN Security Council must vote on renewing UNAMA's mandate before it expires June 17 — a critical flashpoint as Russia's new Taliban military partnership may shape Moscow's position on the mandate scope and human rights monitoring. Pakistan dismissed the Russia-Taliban deal as non-threatening to air operations (June 4). Pakistan Defense Minister Asif rejected Taliban Supreme Leader Akhundzada's informal TTP warning as 'insufficient' (June 3). Paigard News Agency director Jawid Niazi enters Day 32 in Taliban GDI custody — no bail, no charges, no legal access. TOLOnews journalists Mansoor Niazi and Imran Danish remain on bail pending trial after Eid.
